question.text: Two thin, long parallel wires separated by a distance 'd' carry a current of 'i' $A$ in the same direction. They will

options.text: attract each other with a force of $\mu_0 i^2 /(2 \pi \mathrm{d})$
repel each other with a force of $\mu_0 i^2 /(2 \pi \mathrm{d})$
attract each other with a force of $\mu_0 \mathrm{i}^2\left(2 \pi \mathrm{d}^2\right)$
repel each other with a force of $\mu_0 \mathrm{i}^2\left/(2 \pi \mathrm{d}^2\right)$

solution.text: Using the definition of force per unit length due to two long parallel wires carrying currents.
